description:
Local memory and context for you and your AI agent: Markdown notes, documents and tasks on your disk, with an MCP server for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

Tisty keeps what you know on your own machine: notes, documents and tasks, in plain
Markdown files you can read without it. Everything you do is written to an append-only
log, so nothing is lost by accident and a change can be walked back; erasing something
for good is the one step that cannot. No account, no
subscription, no telemetry, no server. Sync, if you want it, goes through a folder both
your machines already reach, and an assistant can come in through a door you open.
Your tasks and your agent's now live apart, Tisty can keep itself up to date, and copying and pasting carries formatting both ways.
- Every task belongs to you or to your agent. Lists show Yours to do and The agent does it apart, and an agent's task closes with its proof once you confirm it; several can be confirmed at once.
- A To confirm chip gathers what an agent said is done or not to do, with both answers on each row.
- An agent sees a task you dropped as one you decided not to do.
- Updates can install on their own. Turn it on in Settings › Help and about: new versions download quietly and install when you quit or open Tisty, never while you work. Copies from the Microsoft Store keep updating through the Store.
- When an update cannot be installed, a button takes you to the website to download it by hand.
- Typing is quicker: the page no longer waits while Tisty saves, syncs or updates Ideas.
- Copying from a page hands other apps formatted text, and pasting from Word, the web, a code editor or a terminal lands as clean, formatted text.
- Right-clicking a page offers the spelling suggestions, cut, copy, paste and what the block can do.
- The Insert menu stays on its line, in four groups with submenus.
- Several spaces or blank lines in a row stay as you type them, also in what you export.
- Delete and Backspace take a table, diagram, widget, formula, fold, sticky note or card whole.
- A document follows the width of the window up to its own width; the paper look is kept for print view.
- Code blocks behave when you type into an empty one or paste one whole.
- The sidebar's menus share one shape, New is always in sight, several rows can be picked and deleted at once, and a delete can be undone.
- Ideas, the diary and Agents keep only their own documents, and deleting a folder hands its contents to the one above.
- Folders nest up to six levels deep. Every computer you sync needs this version: one still on 1.50 keeps working on its own and syncs again once it updates.
- In Agents you can make your own hooks, see their script before they are registered, and check or try them once.
- Tisty's own skills and hooks sit in one row, and one card turns both on.
- Each skill keeps a single copy for all your agents, with a refresh button; older copies are backed up.
- Global shows your own rules, skills and hooks first and Tisty's apart, saying each one's state in words.
- Codex and Antigravity CLI take Tisty's hooks.
- Agents running in WSL, or installed another way, keep finding Tisty, and each WSL distro gets your rules and Tisty's skills once you say yes for it.
- Files Tisty wrote and that were removed are counted in Agents and written again in one click.
- When two sets of rules clash, Tisty asks which one rules.
- One History lists a document's versions and its file's copies.
- A reminder rings when its tone is on, and the main window fits short screens.
- Typing without pause keeps saving, and a file another app holds is tried again.
- A document arriving from another computer shows up without taking the focus.
- The colours of a diagram are drawn safely.

- feat(agents): one copy of each skill in ~/.agents/skills, Cursor's old copies backed up, and a refresh button by @rgdevment in #11

- fix(diagrams): escape the colours a style line gives a node before they reach the drawn SVG by @rgdevment in #20

- feat(update): a failed update offers to download Tisty from the website by @rgdevment in #23
- fix(agents): each place picks how an agent signs, with a live preview, and saved choices keep their meaning by @rgdevment in #24

- feat(agents): Global shows your rules, skills and hooks first, and Tisty's own apart, with their state in words by @rgdevment in #25

- test(brainstorm): the fixture's documents get ids in the order they were added, so the oldest is found first by @rgdevment in #35
